integrity: The proof follows the literal four allocation fractions, Eq. (16), Eq. (17), Appendix B.2, and the practical Wuhan ratios. The source's prose is internally inconsistent, so alternative intended parameterizations would require separate analysis.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the source's instantaneous Section 4 allocation algebra for fixed sigma and fixed state-dependent efficiencies. It does not optimize sigma, solve the full dynamic control problem, or validate other epidemiological conclusions.
title: Hierarchical allocation removes a spurious simplex constraint in a respiratory-resource model
